title: Saying Hi to Sanya

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Sorry, I stopped shooting portraits a few years ago. Camera's got a different purpose now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, I stopped shooting portraits a few years ago. Camera's got a different purpose now.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Whatever my assignment is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever my assignment is.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: It pays the bills. That's all I can ask for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It pays the bills. That's all I can ask for.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: You're not kidding. I used to like how the camera captured truth. That was the whole thing, right? Before all this neural-generated holo imagery started floating around everywhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not kidding. I used to like how the camera captured truth. That was the whole thing, right? Before all this neural-generated holo imagery started floating around everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: I'm questioning that more and more. Any who, what can I do for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm questioning that more and more. Any who, what can I do for you?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Oh. I'm sorry, I just assumed. That's on me. When you spend so much time looking through glass you get tunnel vision. Kinda ironic when you think about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh. I'm sorry, I just assumed. That's on me. When you spend so much time looking through glass you get tunnel vision. Kinda ironic when you think about it.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Photographers are supposed to be unbiased. We see and capture everything and anything. Being too honed on one perspective is really the opposite.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Photographers are supposed to be unbiased. We see and capture everything and anything. Being too honed on one perspective is really the opposite.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: I'm sorry, who are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry, who are you?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Then why are you asking about Zee?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then why are you asking about Zee?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Really? Care to explain a little bit more?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? Care to explain a little bit more?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Oh. That's it? She's probably off on a come down from splurging on a "Level Up!" session.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh. That's it? She's probably off on a come down from splurging on a "Level Up!" session.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Apparently you haven't known Zee for very long. Which begs the question, why do you care?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Apparently you haven't known Zee for very long. Which begs the question, why do you care?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Interesting... She hasn't mentioned you before. But again, that's kind of like Zee. She's in her own world most of the time. Sometimes I think you have to be high to even be near her level.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting... She hasn't mentioned you before. But again, that's kind of like Zee. She's in her own world most of the time. Sometimes I think you have to be high to even be near her level.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Mhm... Well, Zee's kinda her own bird if you know what I mean. Doesn't really fly in a flock or anything like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mhm... Well, Zee's kinda her own bird if you know what I mean. Doesn't really fly in a flock or anything like that.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Oh, ummmm, well I've been on an assignment for a bit, and this whole nightmare trip to the Wastes to try and capture a fungi that blooms once every seventeen years.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, ummmm, well I've been on an assignment for a bit, and this whole nightmare trip to the Wastes to try and capture a fungi that blooms once every seventeen years.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: I did, despite the fact that I got my foot stuck in a fissure. Thought I was gonna have to hack it off at the ankle! Anyway, that was for a bit. I haven't seen Zee since before then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did, despite the fact that I got my foot stuck in a fissure. Thought I was gonna have to hack it off at the ankle! Anyway, that was for a bit. I haven't seen Zee since before then.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Look, Zee tended to wander off quite a bit. She always talked about places beyond the grid, finding neutrality and all that jazz. If I had to guess, she finally found one, which good for her if she did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, Zee tended to wander off quite a bit. She always talked about places beyond the grid, finding neutrality and all that jazz. If I had to guess, she finally found one, which good for her if she did.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: I don't know... Any where with a view? She wanted to see everything, not just what the feeds and ad boards showed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know... Any where with a view? She wanted to see everything, not just what the feeds and ad boards showed.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Eh, maybe. Wait, I remember I did a photo shoot there once - a flash scene at sunrise and she came along.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, maybe. Wait, I remember I did a photo shoot there once - a flash scene at sunrise and she came along.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: I remember her complaining that there wasn't any water or anything. Yeah, no, she definitely preferred with water.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I remember her complaining that there wasn't any water or anything. Yeah, no, she definitely preferred with water.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Right, which means you should probably look in other places?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right, which means you should probably look in other places?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: There are definitely some good angles to shoot out on that floatin' hunk of an industrial step-child.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There are definitely some good angles to shoot out on that floatin' hunk of an industrial step-child.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: If you're head's down that low I wouldn't bother looking for Zee. Trust me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're head's down that low I wouldn't bother looking for Zee. Trust me.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: If you knew her you'd know her dreams brought her into the air. That she liked that line were the sky and the sea nestled together. What did she say? Where they rock one another.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you knew her you'd know her dreams brought her into the air. That she liked that line were the sky and the sea nestled together. What did she say? Where they rock one another.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: A handful of times. She used to date this guy, Finlay--used to joke that he was Fine-ly. She did not have the best sense of humor but you can't hold that against her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A handful of times. She used to date this guy, Finlay--used to joke that he was Fine-ly. She did not have the best sense of humor but you can't hold that against her.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Yeah. Just another day, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Just another day, right?

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: I don't know. I don't think so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. I don't think so.

nodes.speaker: Sanya Predex
nodes.text: Can't recall ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't recall ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not looking to have my picture taken.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not looking to have my picture taken.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not looking to have my picture taken.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not looking to have my picture taken.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know Zee Burke?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know Zee Burke?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you take pictures of?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you take pictures of?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you take pictures of?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you take pictures of?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't sound to happy about that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't sound to happy about that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Don't sound to happy about that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Don't sound to happy about that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Something you love turned into work, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Something you love turned into work, huh?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Something you love turned into work, huh?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Something you love turned into work, huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: True story.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: True story.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doesn't it still capture truth?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't it still capture truth?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Neural-generated is still true. Just straight from the brain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Neural-generated is still true. Just straight from the brain.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Neural-generated is still true. Just straight from the brain.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Neural-generated is still true. Just straight from the brain.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How come?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How come?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No one.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I actually sling food for a living.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I actually sling food for a living.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I actually sling food for a living.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I actually sling food for a living.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A friend of Zee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A friend of Zee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Professor Remo asked me to find you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Professor Remo asked me to find you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Professor Remo asked me to find you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Professor Remo asked me to find you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Zee's missing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Zee's missing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't seem too concerned.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't seem too concerned.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's what I'm told.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what I'm told.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Honestly, I'm kind of into her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Honestly, I'm kind of into her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Honestly, I'm kind of into her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Honestly, I'm kind of into her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Trying to help out a friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Trying to help out a friend.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Trying to help out a friend.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Trying to help out a friend.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When was the last time you saw her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When was the last time you saw her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: When was the last time you saw her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: When was the last time you saw her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you get the shot?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you get the shot?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you have any idea where she'd go?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you have any idea where she'd go?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you have any idea where she'd go?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you have any idea where she'd go?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know where she liked to hang out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know where she liked to hang out?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you know where she liked to hang out?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you know where she liked to hang out?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So maybe Skyhigh Gardens?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So maybe Skyhigh Gardens?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe the Sewers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe the Sewers?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did she like it there?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did she like it there?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where in Sky High?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where in Sky High?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like the Oil Rig?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like the Oil Rig?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She had left the Docks though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She had left the Docks though.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She had left the Docks though.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She had left the Docks though.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you been there with her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you been there with her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you been there with her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you been there with her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why do you say that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why do you say that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I know her well enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I know her well enough.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I know her well enough.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I know her well enough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good luck with your shoot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good luck with your shoot.

nodes.text: Her professor came to my restaurant and seemed worried.
